description_en: Queries the whitelist of an endpoint service
description_zh: 调用ListVpcEndpointServiceUsers接口，查询终端节点服务的服务白名单
kebab_example: aliyun privatelink list-vpc-endpoint-service-users --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-id epsrv-hp3vpx8yqxblby3i0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListVpcEndpointServiceUsers

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the endpoint service that you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的终端节点服务所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

If this is your first request and no next requests are to be performed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

If a next request is to be performed, set the value to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，取值范围：1~1000，默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account in the whitelist of the endpoint service
parameters.help_zh: 服务白名单阿里云账号ID
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the user list in the whitelist of the endpoint service
parameters.help_zh:
服务白名单用户列表类型：
Users
UserARNs
parameters.name: user_list_type

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page

NextToken.description_en:
The returned value of NextToken is a pagination token, which can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

If no value is returned for NextToken, no next requests are performed.

If a value is returned for NextToken, the value can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned

UserARNs.description_en: The whitelists in the format of Aliyun Resource Name (ARN)
UserARNs.description_zh: ARN格式的用户白名单列表

UserARN.description_en: The whitelist in the format of ARN

Users.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud accounts in the whitelist of the endpoint service
Users.description_zh: 服务白名单阿里云账号集合

UserId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account in the whitelist of the endpoint service
UserId.description_zh: 服务白名单阿里云账号ID
